nonBlockingRisks: The repair remains concentrated in the large launcher module, so future maintenance could couple routing, review binding, tracing, and cancellation behavior; this task appropriately avoids broader refactoring.

Windows cancellation uses forced process-tree termination because Node cannot safely deliver console signals to the child tree; deterministic observation and fail-closed handling must remain aligned with the packet's graceful-cancellation intent.
